assumptions.scope: All point pairs in the declared function domain. Blockwise constants are uniform in the remaining fixed variables.

assumptions.description: For each fixed $x$, $-f(x,\cdot)$ is $\mu_y$-strongly convex, uniformly in $x$.

Public initial point; the objective-gap or distance term refers to the same solution or value function explicitly specified in this entry

description_paragraphs: The spaces are $X=\mathbb R^{d_x}$ and $Y=\mathbb R^{d_y}$.
The function $f$ is jointly $\beta$-smooth, uniformly $\mu_x$-strongly convex in $x$, and uniformly $\mu_y$-strongly concave in $y$; $\beta\ge\max\{\mu_x,\mu_y\}>0$.
A unique saddle point $z^\star$ exists, and the public initial point satisfies $\|z_0-z^\star\|_2\le R$.
source_fields.parameter_domain_description: $R^2$: positive real; $\beta$: positive real; $d$: integer at least 2; $\varepsilon$: positive real; $\mu_x$: $0<\mu_x\le\beta$; $\mu_y$: $0<\mu_y\le\beta$. Derived quantities are defined in the parameter table. Each region states any additional accuracy and dimension conditions.

description_paragraphs: Do not use a global gap that may be infinite on an unbounded domain.
source_fields.finiteness_conditions: compact domain and continuous data, or the specific coercivity/existence promise stated in MODEL
source_fields.normalization: exactly as displayed; no square/norm interchange

description_paragraphs: Public inputs include block dimensions $d_x,d_y$ and $R^2$, $\beta$, $\varepsilon$, $\mu_x$, and $\mu_y$, together with the stated initial points and feasible-set information. Analytic representations of hidden functions, operators, and matrices are not supplied.
Return the exact complete joint gradient, without function values or a Hessian.

operations.coupling: Deterministic exact responses with repeated queries allowed; stochastic sample-reuse permissions are irrelevant.

feedback_quality.description: Exact responses from the same hidden object fixed before interaction

operations.order_convention: Derivative order refers to the scalar payoff $f$. The joint gradient has two blocks; the response signature specifies whether a Hessian or complete derivative jet is supplied.

public_inputs: Public inputs include block dimensions $d_x,d_y$ and $R^2$, $\beta$, $\varepsilon$, $\mu_x$, and $\mu_y$, together with the stated initial points and feasible-set information. Analytic representations of hidden functions, operators, and matrices are not supplied.

source_fields.allowed_postprocessing: arbitrary measurable postprocessing; unqueried output permitted unless restriction says otherwise
description_paragraphs: Return a feasible pair $\widehat{z}=(\widehat{x},\widehat{y})\in X\times Y$.

The output may be any measurable postprocessing of the history, including an unqueried point, average, or convex combination. It must satisfy the stated domain and feasibility requirements; no additional function value or computable certificate is required.
source_fields.feasibility: output must belong to stated output domain

components.description: The number of complete exact joint-gradient calls.

description_paragraphs: Each joint-gradient response increments $N_{\rm grad}$ by one.
Use a fixed worst-case budget: calls never exceed the prespecified $N$ on any instance or random execution path. Earlier stopping within the budget is permitted.

Count all information calls for one instance and one requested accuracy, including initialization. Exact-real arithmetic, storage, and solving known models from public inputs and returned data are uncharged. This query-complexity quantity does not certify arithmetic or bit complexity.
source_fields.precision_model: exact real responses; arithmetic and bit costs uncharged; no finite-bit conclusion
source_fields.scalarization: only the explicitly selected query component is optimized; all auxiliary costs retained

algorithms.adaptivity: arbitrary measurable adaptive queries and outputs
description_paragraphs: Any measurable sequential adaptive deterministic algorithm is allowed. Queries and outputs may use the complete history, with no additional span, zero-support, communication, or memory restriction.
algorithms.internal_computation: exact real arithmetic and arbitrary measurable transcript-based internal computation uncharged; no bound on arithmetic or bits is inferred
algorithms.parallelism: sequential; parallel rounds not identified with calls

aggregation_order: instancewise expectation/probability of the complete metric; suprema inside metric remain inside expectation
description_paragraphs: The same deterministic algorithm must satisfy the guarantee for every admissible instance.
guarantees.quantifier_order: choose a single algorithm from public inputs, then all compatible hidden instances and legal oracle rules
guarantees.time_uniformity: fixed target accuracy; not an anytime guarantee
